messages:
Marta: Small follow-up on the batch rerank play: preview table shows "first 50 rows" but our toast currently says 50 rows imported even when filters applied. Should the toast reflect filtered counts?

Sam: Toast should reflect parsed rows, not filtered view. So keep it: "50 rows imported". But make the toast link to a quick view that says "50 parsed, 12 shown after filters".

Jun: For clarity, add a subtle pill next to the table header that shows "Showing 12 of 50" when filters active. Keyboard accessible.

Aisha: Accessibility: when filters change the table row count, announce via aria-live="polite": "Table updated. Showing 12 of 50 rows."

Marta: Also debating whether the rerank toggle should be global or per-table. Pros for global: consistent across pages. Pros for per-table: more control during analysis. Any preferences?

Sam: Per-table works better for user research. We can add a top-level preference in settings later.

Jun: Agreed. Add small persistent indicator in the console header if any table has rerank enabled: "Rerank active" so users know it's not global.

Aisha: Screen reader note: toggles must be labelled with context: "Rerank (this table)" vs "Rerank (global)". Also ensure state is announced on toggle.

Marta: I'll mock per-table toggle with pill and toast copy and sync with product docs. Final question: export should include current filters by default. Opt-out checkbox in modal to export raw parsed rows. Good?

Sam: keep filters-on default. Add tiny link "Export raw parsed rows" under modal if advanced users want it.

Marta: Perfect. I'll update mocks and ping for final sign-off.
_meta: follow-up thread on rerank and export counts, accessibility nits
